mentions.name: Performance Review Management Platform
mentions.description: This platform manages performance reviews without requiring steep costs or deep integration into HRMS platforms. It offers direct performance reviews, 360° reviews, and recording of wins and lessons (something often overlooked), aiming to serve as a platform for team and individualized growth accessible to small and large businesses alike.
mentions.problem: Existing performance review solutions demand steep costs and deep integration into HRMS platforms, and recording of wins and lessons is often overlooked; the author needed one for themselves and the teams they run.
mentions.audience: Small and large businesses, including managers and the teams they run.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a performance review (PR) management platform that doesn't require a steep cost and deep integration into HRMS platforms.

evidence.value: I'm working on a performance review (PR) management platform that doesn't require a steep cost and deep integration into HRMS platforms.
